summary: Full E2E test of River Road Custom Metal Fabrication app. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (health, auth login/me with/without/bad token, quote create incl. validation 422s, admin list/stats with 401 unauth, full CRUD flow with PATCH status + filter + DELETE + 404 on re-delete). Frontend: Public site loads with all sections (hero, about, services, equipment, industries, gallery, quote). Hero CTA scrolls to #quote. Quote form submits successfully via POST /api/quotes, shows 'Quote request received' toast, and resets. Admin login: invalid creds show error toast; valid creds set rr_token in localStorage and redirect to /admin. /admin redirects to /admin/login when no token. Dashboard: stat cards populate (total/new/in_review/contacted/closed), quote rows render, status select updates server-side (PATCH 200), view dialog opens with full details, delete removes row (window.confirm accepted), logout clears token and redirects to /admin/login.

minor.issue: FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in favor of lifespan handlers (Starlette/FastAPI 0.100+). Works fine but emits DeprecationWarning.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting. Playbook recommends lockout after 5 failed attempts; current impl returns 401 indefinitely.

CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True. Spec-wise browsers ignore credentials with wildcard origin; not currently breaking since frontend uses Bearer header (not cookies), but should be tightened for prod.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown handlers to lifespan context manager.
(Optional, low priority) Add basic rate-limiting / lockout to /api/auth/login if security playbook compliance is required.
(Optional) Replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' with explicit preview/production origins when allow_credentials=True.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT auth uses Bearer header + localStorage (not httpOnly cookies). Acceptable for simple admin console but XSS-exposed; documented in test_credentials.md so consistent with implementation choice.
AdminDashboard.jsx is 486 lines — borderline-OK; could be split into Header / StatsGrid / QuotesTable / DetailDialog components for maintainability, but not blocking.
Backend properly excludes Mongo _id via projection {'_id': 0} on reads — correct.
Password hashing uses bcrypt with gensalt (format starts with $2b$) — verified by login flow passing.
Seed admin block correctly UPDATES existing admin's password_hash if .env ADMIN_PASSWORD changed (idempotent) — verified by login working after re-seed.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with /api prefix — correct; no hardcoded URLs.
All interactive elements expose data-testid attributes — excellent testability.
seed_data_creation: Test quotes prefixed with 'TEST' or email 'test_*@example.com' created during pytest and one Playwright submission; all cleaned up at the end (Playwright quote was deleted by the admin-delete test step, pytest quotes removed via Mongo cleanup script). DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows working end-to-end. Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers 18 cases incl. CRUD persistence checks. Use admin creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Token stored as 'rr_token' in localStorage; Authorization: Bearer header via axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js. Status enum: new|in_review|contacted|closed.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The single 'FAIL: empty submit did not succeed' line in the Playwright log was a false positive: sonner toasts from the prior successful submission persisted in the DOM (~5s) and the next test's locator counted that lingering toast. HTML5 required attributes on the form natively block empty submissions — confirmed by manual inspection.
